deviations.detail: Upstream repo_commit was empty and the image used a mutable tag; this suite pins both repository and verifier image.
The upstream verifier searched Visit* controller/service/test files although the task requests WeightRecord. This suite grades HTTP behavior and H2 persistence instead.
The shared task text makes JSON fields, ownership checks, positive validation, no-side-effect failures, and descending recordDate order explicit for both conditions.
